title: Orchestration heatmap for multi-surface launches
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: We need a single pane (heatmap + timeline) that operationalizes coordinated launches across Runtime, Console, and API surfaces so engineering, product, and support can make deterministic decisions during rollout windows. This ticket creates the orchestration heatmap artifact and a lightweight operational runbook that the release conductor and on-call leads use during launch week.

Scope: deliver a living heatmap visualization (spreadsheet + Confluence page) that maps: release windows, per-service gating signals, expected traffic/cost ramps, rollback criteria, owner on-call, and escalation path. Also produce a one-page runbook and a 30-min rehearsal checklist. Not in scope: implementing automation (CI/CD hooks) to trigger rollouts; that will be follow-up work once the heatmap format is validated.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap Confluence page exists with columns: date/time window, runtime model variants, console feature flags, API routes, expected QPS delta, cost delta, gating signal (latency/errors), rollback criteria, owner/backup, and dependencies
Runbook PDF linked from heatmap: includes contact matrix, escalation steps, and canary rollback playbook
Cross-team rehearsal scheduled and executed (docs capture outcomes) with Engineering, QA, Console PM, Support, and SRE
All owners confirm readiness and stake their go/no-go criteria in the heatmap (sign-off comments on Confluence)
Post-rehearsal list of 3 follow-up engineering tasks created and triaged into ENG backlog
tasks: Sync with runtime leads to collect model variant timelines (Marco) — 2025-01-20
Console PM workshop to map feature flags and rollout gates (Lena Ortiz) — 2025-01-22
SRE to define SLO thresholds and automated alerts for gating signals (Priya Verma) — 2025-01-24
Full cross-team rehearsal (2025-01-31) — capture outcomes and update heatmap
Create follow-up ENG tickets for automation + dashboarding (post-rehearsal)
Share final artifact with GTM and Customer Success and schedule briefing (2025-02-04)
comments: 2025-01-16 Marco Li: Draft template uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcExampleHeatmap. Please review columns I added for 'expected QPS delta' and 'cost delta' — think we should keep cost delta optional for internal launches.

2025-01-18 Priya Verma (SRE): Suggest adding 'traceroute/checklist' entry for KV cache warming as a gating signal for runtime. Latency spikes in canaries historically happen when KV cache cold starts coincide with traffic ramp. See incident playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/kv-coldstart
2025-01-20 Lena Ortiz (Console PM): Confirmed feature-flag matrix for console; adding a soft-start path to enable UI features on 5% of accounts first. I'll own console-side rollback steps.

2025-01-22 Aisha Patel: Rehearsal scheduled for 2025-01-31 16:00 UTC. Invites sent to runtime-eng, console-eng, api-eng, SRE, QA, and Support. Agenda in Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rehearsalAgenda

2025-01-31 Rehearsal notes (Marco Li): Rehearsal hit two items: (1) automated canary didn't report request-level traces due to tracer sampling misconfig — added ENG-3310 to fix; (2) Support needs a simplified 'what broke' blurb for postmortem email templates — added PM-17445
2025-02-01 Aisha Patel: Heatmap updated with rehearsal outcomes and owner sign-offs. Requesting final check from SRE and Support before publishing as canonical.
2025-02-02 Priya Verma: SRE sign-off provided. Added monitoring dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/launch-heatmap-dashboard and set alert thresholds.
decisions: Adopt a single heatmap artifact (Confluence canonical) rather than multiple per-team spreadsheets — reduces drift and makes sign-offs discoverable.
Use a staged regional rollout windows approach: EU first, NA second, APAC last for this train to reduce cross-region blast radius.
Keep cost-impact column present but optional for initial launches; escalate to Optimize team for automation later.
Perform a mandatory cross-team rehearsal at least 2 business days before any major release window for runtime, console, or API changes.
risks: Manual artifact becomes stale if owners don't update — mitigated by setting owner reminders and adding a pre-launch checklist step.
SRE alert thresholds may be too strict, triggering false rollbacks; we will tune during canary and rehearsal.
Dependency on ENG automation (not in scope) may slow subsequent launches; track via dependencies and follow-up tickets.
Support and GTM may need simplified comms; rehearsal surfaced gaps in templated messages.
next_steps: Publish canonical Confluence heatmap and notify owners (Aisha) — 2025-02-02
Create follow-up ENG tickets for automation of gating signals (ENG-3310, ENG-3311)
Schedule GTM/customer success briefing and share runner-up checklist (Marco) — 2025-02-04
Plan quarters OKR alignment to include heatmap automation and dashboarding (Q2 planning)
